title: Weyl group of semisimple symmetric space
summary: This paper investigates a generalization of the notion of the Weyl group of a real reductive Lie group to a semisimple symmetric space $G/H$. First, we show that the group structure of the Weyl group of $G/H$ is independent of the choice of split Cartan subalgebras of $G/H$ and the choice of Cartan involutions of $G$ stabilizing $H$. After that, we can understand all elements of the Weyl group of $G/H$ by comparing the Weyl group of some reductive Lie group associated to $G/H$.
